name: Kill reward under Level 5: the line steepens, XP a health point x (5 / monster Level) ^ 1.1 (GR-5 under Level 5, D-1 check C1; RULED by the designer, 08-designer-d3.md section 2)
why: Check C1 (08 section 6): on the proposed game every weapon card took 36 to 42 hunted minutes to Level 5 in the Mill Cellar. The cause is R12 (GR-5): its reference kill-health line, fitted from Level 10, pays a Level 2 rat half the tree. Under Level 5 XP a health point is multiplied by (5 / the monster's Level) ^ 1.1, a content number, never the hero's; from Level 5 up nothing moves. The designer ruled 1.1 over the measured 0.85: every starting card reaches Level 5 in 16.2 to 19.2 minutes with no death (08-designer-d3.md section 2.1)
